Prevention: Lalupate flower ( Euphorbia pulcherrima ) etc. as they may serve as alternate hosts.
Whiteflies are repelled by silver- or aluminum- colored mulches.
Place reflective polyethylene mulches on planting beds before seeding or transplanting to reduce infestation levels.
Enhance natural enemies by encouraging flowering plants near fields and by avoiding broad-spectrum insecticides.
Apply balanced crop nutrition and don't overdose nitrogen, so that the crop can better cope with pest damage.
Monitoring: Hang yellow sticky traps on sticks at the level of the apical portion of the plant @ 5 traps per ropani, placed evenly throughout the field.
Visit field regularly at least weekly to observe whitefly nymphs & adults on lower leaf surfaces; also look for chlorotic spots and sooty mould on upper leaf surfaces.
Consider action when more than one whitefly adult or five nymphs are observed per leaflet.
Direct Control: Spray neem-based pesticides (Azadirachtin 0.03% EC @ 5ml/L water, 25L water per ropani) and repeat after 7 days, preferably in the evening time.
Lecanicillium lecanii 1.15% WP @ 5g/L of water (25L water per ropani) and repeat after 15 days, preferably in the evening time.
Restrictions: When using a pesticide, always wear protective clothing and follow the instructions on the product label.
Do not use chemicals with the same mode of action year after year as this can lead to resistance.
Always consult the most recent list of registered pesticides (PCPB).
